startUrls.title: Product / listing URLs
startUrls.description: Catalog product URLs (…/p/MLC123) or listing URLs (articulo.mercadolibre.cl/MLC-123-…_JM).

itemIds.title: Item / product IDs
itemIds.description: IDs like MLC37981310 or MLA41149389. Bare numbers use the Country field.

country.title: Default country (site)
country.description: Used only for bare numeric IDs.

maxReviews.title: Max reviews per product
maxReviews.description: Upper limit of reviews saved per product.

includeQuestions.title: Include questions & answers
includeQuestions.description: Fetch questions & answers via the official Mercado Libre API. Needs mlClientId + mlClientSecret (your own free ML developer app) or mlAccessToken. For catalog products (/p/) the listings found in the reviews are used.

maxQuestions.title: Max questions per listing
maxQuestions.description: Upper limit of questions saved per listing.

maxListingsPerProduct.title: Max listings per catalog product (questions)
maxListingsPerProduct.description: For catalog products (/p/), questions are fetched for up to this many seller listings found in the reviews.

mlClientId.title: Mercado Libre app Client ID
mlClientId.description: Client ID (App ID) of your app at developers.mercadolibre.com. Used with mlClientSecret to get a token automatically (client_credentials).

mlClientSecret.title: Mercado Libre app Client Secret
mlClientSecret.description: Secret Key of your Mercado Libre app. Stored encrypted, never logged.

mlAccessToken.title: Mercado Libre API access token
mlAccessToken.description: Optional: a ready OAuth access token instead of Client ID/Secret (expires after 6 h).

aiInsights.title: AI insights per product (optional)
aiInsights.sectionCaption: 🤖 AI insights (optional, bring your own key)
aiInsights.description: Adds one 'ai-insight' row per product: sentiment %, top pros, cons, themes, feature requests, notable quotes and an executive summary. Requires your own Gemini or OpenAI API key. US$0.20 per 1,000 reviews analyzed (only when AI insights are on); AI tokens are billed by your provider. Off by default.

aiProvider.title: AI provider
aiProvider.description: Leave empty to auto-detect from the key (keys starting with 'sk-' are OpenAI, others Gemini).

aiApiKey.title: AI API key
aiApiKey.description: Your Gemini (aistudio.google.com) or OpenAI key. Used only for the AI calls; stored encrypted and never logged.

aiLanguage.title: AI output language
aiLanguage.description: Language of the AI text (e.g. English, Spanish, Portuguese).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: RESIDENTIAL proxies recommended if requests get blocked.
